def title_of(html: str) -> str:
    """Text between the first <title> and the following </title> in html, or "" when absent."""
    ex title_of("<html><title>Hello</title></html>") == "Hello"
    ex title_of("<html></html>") == ""
    ex title_of("<title>unclosed") == ""
    ex title_of("<title></title>") == ""
    _, open_sep, rest = html.partition("<title>")
    if open_sep == "":
        return ""
    title, close_sep, _ = rest.partition("</title>")
    if close_sep == "":
        return ""
    return title
